acceptance: Decide and record one of: an up-to-date or re-run requirement for PRs whose paths overlap recently merged soundness/oracle paths; a bounded combined-tree check at arm time; or automated fast revert of the first-red culprit. Implement it, and show a replay of the #3734 + #3836 pair that the mechanism would have caught before merge. Update the ledger row and the composed-tree evidence in dlv2-evidence-reconcile.
description: Dev-loop v2 retired the merge queue (ledger row "Combined-tree validation before merge": composition failures are detected after merge and handled by revert). Evidence: #3836 (head 54f6bb3eb, CI green) added test_no_loop_time_summary_line_reaches_the_step_summary_before_the_redaction_step; #3734 (merged earlier; the review driver now writes "disk scan of N root(s) ... 0 hit(s)" lines to the step summary) was not in #3836's head. Merged together the test failed on every later PR and on trunk run 41166847029 (2026-10-31T04:01Z). make pr-arm then refused every PR, including the fix #3853, until an owner "Fix-forward authorized" comment was posted; six release-UAT fixes waited about 9 h. Trunk went red again on abc110263 (see trunk-red-oracle-same-head-rerun-tests-20261101).
